Q: In ruby, use `.` or `::` for class method documentation and comments? A:

The Ruby Style Guide (which Rubocop "enforces") differentiates between the two usage - :: for Constants and . for Methods.

So, be kind to other devs (and your future self) and keep code and documentation consistent.

rubystyle.guide/#double-colons

Use :: only to reference constants ... not ... for regular method calls.

rubystyle.guide/#colon-method-definition

Do not use :: to define class methods

Q: How to handle Stripe processing fees in Flutter when card country is unknown? A:

To estimate Stripe’s processing fee, you need your pricing plan, the payment amount and the payment method details (type, brand, and whether it’s domestic or cross-border). You can get the latter with a ConfirmationToken object and the payment_method_preview attribute. Read more here.

If you’re using Stripe Connect to make a destination charge from a platform account, you can charge the default large application fee first then refund the extra amount automatically. Read more here.

Finally, this article shares best practices for credit card surcharges and you can contact Stripe support for further recommendations.

Q: Using @attribute [Authorize(Policy = "...")] throws IAuthenticationService error in Blazor Server app A:

In the code you posted, you have:

app.UseAuthorization()

but tho code is missing the app.UseAuthentication(); call, i.e.:

app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();
app.MapRazorComponents<App>().AddInteractiveServerRenderMode()
